items.name: Aled's Tally-Stick Charm
items.lore: A drover's notched tally, every notch a debt paid. Someone has carved one more.

items.name: Torc of the Barrow-King
items.lore: Old gold that was never meant to see the sun. It sits warm against the throat.

items.name: Henge-Stone Bracer
items.lore: A band of blue stone cut from a fallen lintel. It hums faintly at dusk.

items.name: Drover's Oilskin
items.lore: Waxed against the plain's rain, patched at every seam by someone who cared.

items.name: Huntington's Horn
items.lore: A plains hunter's horn. Blow it, and every Huntington within a mile comes running - or used to.

items.name: Chalk-White Mantle
items.lore: Pale as the hill figure. It never seems to stain.

items.name: Basilisk-Eye Ring
items.lore: A grey eye set in silver. Don't stare at it too long.

items.name: Hide of the White Horse
items.lore: Soft, white, and strangely cold. The plain has felt emptier since.
